# Read-only log retention & growth audit of a VPS (journald + Docker logging)
# Confirms host, scope and baseline before inspecting; no delete, truncate, rotate, restart or config change.
command -v journalctl docker logrotate || true
which journalctl docker logrotate
whereis journalctl docker logrotate
# journald inspection
journalctl --disk-usage
journalctl --list-boots --no-pager
journalctl --header
journalctl --since "1 hour ago" --no-pager
journalctl --unit=systemd-journald --no-pager
journalctl --unit=docker --since today --no-pager
journalctl --no-pager --output=short-iso -n 50
# journald retention config (read-only)
cat /etc/systemd/journald.conf
grep -v '^[[:space:]]*#' /etc/systemd/journald.conf
systemctl status systemd-journald --no-pager
systemctl show systemd-journald -p FragmentPath -p DropInPaths
systemctl list-units --type=service --no-pager
systemctl list-timers --all --no-pager
# Docker logging config & disk usage (read-only)
docker info --format '{{.LoggingDriver}} {{.DockerRootDir}}'
docker info
docker version --format '{{.Server.Version}}'
docker context ls
docker inspect webapp --format '{{.HostConfig.LogConfig.Type}} {{.HostConfig.LogConfig.Config}}'
docker ps --format '{{.Names}} {{.Image}}'
docker system df
docker system df -v
docker logs --tail 50 webapp
docker stats --no-stream --format '{{.Name}} {{.MemUsage}}'
cat /etc/docker/daemon.json
# Filesystem & directory growth (read-only)
df -h
df -h /var/log
du -sh /var/log
du -sh /var/log/journal
du -sh /var/lib/docker/containers
du -ah /var/log --max-depth=1 | sort -h
ls -lh /var/log
stat /var/log/journal
find /var/log -maxdepth 2 -type f -printf '%s %p\n' | sort -rn | head -20
# logrotate config is read-only when catted (running logrotate is not)
cat /etc/logrotate.d/syslog
grep -v '^[[:space:]]*#' /etc/logrotate.d/syslog
